hypothesis: Context anchor: plain cross-sectional momentum (no residualization) on log returns, L=63,g=3,tstat,rank,K=1 is weakly positive but beta-contaminated; sets the reference the residual version must beat on regime balance.
Residual momentum baseline (EW factor, w_beta=270, L=63, g=3, tstat, rank, K=1) has positive net IS Sharpe @1x with more balanced bull/bear/chop profile than e01.
Formation plateau: tstat scaling, L in {42,63,126,168,252} (others at baseline) shows a contiguous positive plateau over 2-8 weeks; falsifier F1 tests the median of L in {42,63,126,168}.
Scaling comparison: raw-sum residual formation across the same L sweep has lower plateau median than tstat (vol-normalization helps cross-sectional comparability).

Beta-estimation robustness: at L in {42,63,126} (tstat,g=3,rank,K=1), alternatives {w_beta 180,540} x {EW,DVW} do not beat baseline (270,EW) by >0.3 at the plateau minimum; baseline is retained by parsimony rule 4.
Skip-gap: g in {0,6} does not beat g=3 by >0.3 at L*=63 (baseline otherwise); g=3 retained by rule 5.
EMA smoothing K in {3,6,9} cuts turnover (~194x/yr at K=1) enough to lift the 2x-stress Sharpe materially while keeping 1x within 0.1 of the best; rule 6 picks the smallest such K.

Concentrated top/bottom-12 equal-weight does not beat centered-rank weighting by >0.3 at BOTH 1x and 2x at the selected params (EW,270,L=63,g=3,tstat,K=3); rank retained by rule 7 for breadth+turnover.
Final spec (resid,EW,w_beta=270,L=63,g=3,tstat,rank,K=3) passes all rule-8 gates: 2x-stress Sharpe>0, median names/side>=5, ex-bull2021 Sharpe>0, funding-on>=funding-off sanity (F4).

Plateau confirmation: one-step perturbations of the final spec (L 42/126, w_beta 180/540, g 0/6, K 2/4, market DVW) all stay within ~0.4 of the final 1x Sharpe and remain >0.7 — the selected point is a plateau, not a peak.
